title: zanthoxylum dinklagei
intro: Zanthoxylum dinklagei, commonly known as the West African prickly ash, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae. This plant is valued for its traditional use in folk medicine, particularly in West Africa, where it is used to treat various ailments and promote overall well-being. The health benefits of Zanthoxylum dinklagei include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which make it a potential treatment for conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, phenolic compounds, and essential oils, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and antiseptic effects.
